#  11935 - English - Pre-intermediate A2 Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11935 - module is no longer offered from SS 2022**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **English - Pre-intermediate A2**  |  
|  Englischkurs Sprachlevel A2   |  
| Department:  |  ZES - Language Centre   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Riebow, Ute 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 2 semesters  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  12   |  
| Learning Outcome:  | At the end of the module the students can understand sentences and commonly used expressions concerning fields of existential importance like personal and familial information, shopping or daily routines. They are able to agree on simple tasks which require a direct exchange of information on common and familiar issues and can describe aspects of their personal background, their immediate environment and of existential needs with simple phrases.  |  
| Contents:  | 
  * Reading and understanding simple texts, understanding simple listening texts
  * Practising grammatical structures (Simple Present and Present Continiuous, adjectives and adverbs, Simple Past, countable and uncountable nouns, comparison, be going to, Present Perfect)
  * Improving writing skills (descriptions, blogs, formal and informal emails)

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Course participants should have basic knowledge of English.  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Seminar / 8 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 240 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * Headway English A2
  * Additional material

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * 12 written tests (45 min each)
  * Every test accounts for one-twelfth of the final grade

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  |  _**College-Module - In case of failure no repetition possible!**__(see §7 paragraph 3 of Examination- and Study Regulation from 2018)_  |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * 019075 Course Englisch A2.1 (neu)

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
